summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements in AI technology, including NVIDIA's harnessing of Vera CPU for chip design and OpenAI's launch of ChatGPT Health. Other notable stories include Anthropic's release of Opus 5 and Meta's upgrade of its AI chatbot. The industry is also seeing increased investment, with AMD investing up to $5 billion in Anthropic.
insight: The recent OpenAI hacking incident has sparked a renewed focus on AI cybersecurity, with lawmakers preparing to introduce an 'AI Kill Switch Act' that would require AI companies to shut down or throttle their systems on orders from the Department of Homeland Security.
highlights: NVIDIA harnesses Vera CPU to speed up design of next-generation CPUs and GPUs
OpenAI launches ChatGPT Health, allowing users to connect medical records and Apple Health data
Anthropic releases Opus 5, a more capable and efficient AI model
